title: ShepHerd configuration file
description: ShepHerd test-runner configuration: the system's crates/boards/links, link settings, command parameter values, command-line variables, and included files. See the ShepHerd "Configuration files" user guide for full details: https://shepherd-fwk.docs.cern.ch/user-guide/config-file.html

allOf.errorMessage: Top level must be a YAML mapping, e.g. with keys like "system", "variables", "contexts", "link_settings", "include".

system.description: Declares the crates, boards, and links in the system, and how they're connected.

allOf.errorMessage: system must be a mapping with at least "crates", "boards", "links" (and optionally "external_boards", "daq_boards", "frontends").

crates.description: Crates in the system, keyed by an arbitrary crate ID string (e.g. "myCrate").
crates.errorMessage: crates must be a mapping of crate ID to crate properties.

additionalProperties.description: A crate's physical location and CSP identity.

allOf.errorMessage: A crate entry must be a mapping with "building", "rack", "height", "csp_id" (and optional "description").

rack.description: The crate's rack within the building, e.g. "E1A05".

height.description: Position of the bottom of the crate in the rack, in rack units (U) — i.e. the lowest occupied U.

description.description: Optional free-text note about the crate. Defaults to an empty string if omitted.

csp_id.description: The crate's ID for the CSP protocol. Checked against the sender-identifier field in CSP link filler words, to verify the link map in this file matches what's implemented in hardware.

boards.description: Boards in the system, keyed by an arbitrary board ID string (e.g. "boardN").
boards.errorMessage: boards must be a mapping of board ID to board properties.

additionalProperties.description: A board's network address and crate slot.

allOf.errorMessage: A board entry must be a mapping with "hostname", "crate", "slot" (and optional "port").

hostname.description: The board's hostname or IP address.

port.description: TCP port of the HERD application on this board. Defaults to 3000 if omitted.

crate.description: ID of the crate hosting this board — must match a key under system.crates.

slot.description: The board's logical slot number in its crate.

external_boards.description: Boards that send or receive data but aren't configured by this framework — add an entry here only when a test receives data from such a board. A link can't have both endpoints outside system.boards.
external_boards.errorMessage: external_boards must be a mapping of board ID to externally-controlled board properties.

additionalProperties.description: An externally-controlled board's crate/slot and output channel mapping.

allOf.errorMessage: An external board entry must be a mapping with "crate", "slot", "outputs".

crate.description: ID of the crate hosting this board.

slot.description: The board's logical slot number in its crate.

outputs.description: Maps each of the board's main data-processing FPGAs to the CSP IDs of its output channels.
outputs.errorMessage: outputs must be a mapping of FPGA name to a CSP output channel index list.

additionalProperties.description: CSP output channel IDs for this FPGA, e.g. "0-127".

daq_boards.description: DAQ-800 / DTH-400 boards used for links to/from the DAQ system.
daq_boards.errorMessage: daq_boards must be a mapping of DAQ board ID to its input/output properties.

additionalProperties.description: A DAQ board's input and output port mappings, each keyed by processor name.

allOf.errorMessage: A DAQ board entry must be a mapping with "inputs" and "outputs".

inputs.description: Maps each processor name to the index list of its input ports.
inputs.errorMessage: inputs must be a mapping of processor name to an input port index list.

additionalProperties.description: Input port indices on this processor, e.g. "0-23".

outputs.description: Maps each processor name to the index list of its output ports.
outputs.errorMessage: outputs must be a mapping of processor name to an output port index list.

additionalProperties.description: Output port indices on this processor, e.g. "0-4".

frontends.description: Frontend modules, keyed by an arbitrary module ID (e.g. "feX").
frontends.errorMessage: frontends must be a mapping of frontend module ID to its properties.

additionalProperties.description: A frontend module's manufacturing serial and lpGBT physical IDs.

allOf.errorMessage: A frontend entry must be a mapping with "serial" and "lpgbt_fuseids".

lpgbt_fuseids.description: Comma-separated physical lpGBT fuse IDs; position in the list gives the port number starting from port 0 — e.g. "51,32,103" assigns fuse ID 51 to port 0, 32 to port 1, 103 to port 2.

links.description: Links between boards, keyed by an arbitrary link ID (e.g. "linkN"). A comma-separated index list in square brackets in the ID (e.g. "link[0-7]"), combined with a matching index-list string in from/to, expands to multiple links in one entry.
links.errorMessage: links must be a mapping of link ID to link properties.

additionalProperties.description: A single link (or, with a bracketed index range in the link ID, a matching set of links).

allOf.errorMessage: A link entry must be a mapping with "from" and "to".

link_settings.description: Type and format of data sent over board-to-board links (PRBS or CSP), as an ordered list: the first entry sets defaults for all links, then each later entry overrides settings for whichever links it selects via from/to.

contexts.description: Parameter values for commands, organized into named contexts so shared values only need to be specified once. Values are looked up first in the context for the specific board/processor, then in progressively more general contexts (hardware-type-specific, then the shared "processors"/"serviceModules" context).
contexts.errorMessage: contexts must be a mapping of context ID to context properties.

additionalProperties.description: A single context's command parameter values.

allOf.errorMessage: A context entry must be a mapping containing "parameters".

parameters.description: Parameter values for this context, keyed by parameter name (applies to any command), "command:parameter" (one command), "namespace:command:parameter" (one command in one transition), or "§command"/"§namespace:command" (a map of several parameters for one command). The command part may be a comma-separated list to share one value across several commands.
parameters.errorMessage: parameters must be a mapping of parameter/command keys to their values.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: Parameter key must be one or more command names (optionally §-prefixed, comma-separated) followed by up to two optional ":field" suffixes, e.g. "configureRxBuffers,alignMGTs:ids" or "program:package".

anyOf.description: Parameter values for this command, keyed by parameter name.

variables.description: Values settable from the command line with --var str:name=value; a command-line value takes precedence over the one given here.
variables.errorMessage: variables must be a mapping of variable name to value.

include.description: Other YAML config files to merge in, so a system description or parameter set can be reused across configs. May only be used once, at the top level.

indexList.description: A comma-separated list of integers and/or hyphenated ranges, e.g. "1-3,5" expands to indices 1, 2, 3, 5.
indexList.patternErrorMessage: Must be a comma-separated list of integers or ranges, e.g. "0-3,5,7" or "0-123".

linkEndpoint.description: A link endpoint: [board_id, fpga_or_optics_id, channel_index]. The channel index may itself be an index-list string, to expand into multiple links.
linkEndpoint.errorMessage: Must be [board, fpga_or_optics_id, channel_index], e.g. [serenity127, FF_N4_tx, "0-11"].

selector.description: Selects a subset of links by matching their endpoints.

allOf.errorMessage: Must be a mapping with one or more of "board", "processor", "port".

board.description: Regex matched against the board ID.

processor.description: Regex matched against the FPGA/optical-module (processor) ID.

port.description: Regex matched against the port ID if given as a string, or an exact port index if given as an integer.

mode.description: Link operating mode: one of the PRBS test patterns, or a CSP packet spec optionally followed by an idle method.

anyOf.description: A pseudorandom binary sequence (PRBS) link test pattern.
CSP packet spec without an explicit idle method: ["csp", packet_length_frames, packet_period_frames].

CSP packet spec with an explicit idle method: ["csp", packet_length_frames, packet_period_frames, idle_method]. Use "idle1" for links to an Apollo, Serenity, X2O or BMTL1; "idle2" for links to an APx.
anyOf.errorMessage: Must be ["csp", packet-length-in-frames, packet-period-in-frames, "idle1"|"idle2"], e.g. [csp, 128, 256, idle1].

linkSettingsEntry.description: One entry in link_settings. The first entry may set "default: null" to mark it as the fallback applied to all links; other entries use from/to to select the links they override.

allOf.errorMessage: A link_settings entry must be a mapping with optional "default", "from", "to", "mask", "mode".

default.description: Marks this as the default entry applied to all links before later, more specific entries override it. Only meaningful on the first entry.

from.description: Selects links by their sender endpoint.

to.description: Selects links by their receiver endpoint.

mask.description: If true, disables (masks) the selected links instead of setting a mode.

anyOf.errorMessage: A link_settings entry must define "mode" or "mask".
A link_settings entry must define "mode" or "mask".
A non-default link_settings entry must select links via "from" and/or "to".
A non-default link_settings entry must select links via "from" and/or "to".

replaceWith.description: Substitutes a value supplied on the command line via --var str:NAME=value in place of a literal parameter value.

allOf.errorMessage: Must be a mapping with "replace_with", e.g. { replace_with: INPUT_FILE }.

replace_with.description: Name of the command-line variable to substitute in, e.g. "INPUT_FILE".

allOf.errorMessage: Must be a mapping with "type: file" (and optional "path").

path.description: Path to the file. Omit to give a null/empty file value.

paramValue.description: A parameter value: a scalar (bool/int/float/string/null), a file value, a command-line variable substitution, or a vector (array) of any of these — whichever type the command's plugin declares for this parameter.
